outcome: Emotional and behavioral problems at 1.5 years of age
cohort: 172 full-term infants (born during Gestational Weeks 37-42) and their mothers
finding: Infants born via cesarean section had a higher prevalence of emotional and behavioral problems at 1.5 years of age compared to infants born vaginally without medication.
